description: Declare a collection of dlt resources (tables, REST endpoints, or file globs) entirely in YAML across dlt's built-in sql_database, rest_api, and filesystem source engines -- no custom Python module required.
summary: Load a collection of tables/endpoints/files declared entirely in YAML, via dlt's generic sql_database, rest_api, or filesystem source engines.

outputs.description: pandas DataFrame with one row per record from the configured resources (one asset per resource in multi_asset mode; or MaterializeResult if destination is non-SQL / persist_only=true).

asset_name.label: Asset Name
asset_name.description: Name of the asset (or asset prefix, in multi_asset mode) that will hold the data

source_type.label: Source Type
source_type.description: Which dlt built-in generic source engine builds these resources: 'sql_database' (dlt.sources.sql_database.sql_table, one call per declared resource), 'rest_api' (dlt.sources.rest_api.rest_api_source, same config shape as dlt_rest_api_source), or 'filesystem' (dlt.sources.filesystem.filesystem + a csv/parquet/jsonl reader, one per declared resource).

resources.label: Resources
resources.description: One dict per resource (table / endpoint / file-glob). Always requires 'name' (also the destination table name, unless overridden via table_name_map). Optional 'primary_key' (str or list of str) and 'columns' on every source_type. source_type='sql_database': 'columns' (if set) is a list of column names to extract (others excluded) -- or a dict, whose keys are used the same way; types always come from the real database via reflection. Optional per-resource 'schema' overrides the top-level schema_name. source_type='rest_api': requires 'endpoint: {path: ...}' (same shape as dlt_rest_api_source's resources); 'columns' here is a dlt column-schema dict, e.g. {id: {data_type: bigint}}. source_type='filesystem': requires 'file_glob' (e.g. 'orders/*.csv'); optional per-resource 'file_format' overrides the top-level file_format. Optional 'write_disposition' ('append' (dlt's own default) / 'replace' / 'merge', the last needing 'primary_key') -- without it every materialization APPENDS, so re-materializing the same partition duplicates rows; set 'replace' or 'merge' for idempotent re-runs. The remaining keys only take effect in asset_shape='multi_asset' mode (single-shape has one asset, so there's no per-resource asset identity to set them on): 'description', 'owners' (list of str), 'tags' (dict, merged over the component-level asset_tags), 'metadata' (dict, static AssetOut metadata), and 'asset_key' (str, or list of str for a multi-segment key) to fully control that resource's asset key instead of the default '{asset_name}_{resource_name}'.

asset_shape.label: Asset Shape
asset_shape.description: 'single' (default, matches every other multi-table ingestion component in this repo): one asset that unions every resource's rows into one DataFrame, tagged with a `_resource_type` column. 'multi_asset': one independently-materializable asset per resource -- materializing one resource never builds, fetches, or persists the others.

table_name_map.label: Table Name Map
table_name_map.description: Override the destination table name for specific resources, keyed by the resource's declared 'name': {resource_name: destination_table_name}. Resources not listed keep their declared name as the destination table name.

connection_string.label: Connection String
connection_string.description: SQLAlchemy connection string for the source database, e.g. 'postgresql://user:pass@host:5432/db'. Required when source_type='sql_database' (or connection_string_env_var). Use "{{ env('VAR_NAME') }}" for secrets.

connection_string_env_var.label: Connection String Env Var
connection_string_env_var.description: Alternative to connection_string: name of an env var holding the SQLAlchemy connection string. Resolved at run-time.

schema_name.label: Schema Name
schema_name.description: Source database schema name (sql_database only). Per-resource 'schema' overrides this.

client.label: Client
client.description: dlt rest_api_source 'client' config (base_url required; optional auth, headers, paginator -- see dlt_rest_api_source's README for the full shape reference). Required when source_type='rest_api'.

bucket_url.label: Bucket Url (source)
bucket_url.description: Bucket/path URL to read SOURCE files from (e.g. 's3://my-bucket/landing', 'gs://my-bucket/landing', 'az://my-container/landing', or 'file:///local/path'). Required when source_type='filesystem'. Credentials resolve from the cloud provider's standard env vars, same as the destination-side filesystem convention in ../DESTINATIONS.md.

file_format.label: File Format
file_format.description: Reader applied to each matched file (filesystem only). Per-resource 'file_format' overrides this.

destination.label: Destination
destination.description: dlt destination identifier. Leave empty for in-memory DuckDB -> DataFrame mode.

dataset_name.label: Dataset Name
dataset_name.description: Target dataset/schema in the destination. Defaults to the asset name.

persist_only.label: Persist Only
persist_only.description: If True with destination set: emit a MaterializeResult and skip DataFrame return.

destination_credentials_url.label: Destination Credentials Url
destination_credentials_url.description: Inline connection string passed to dlt's destination factory.

fields.name: port
fields.label: Port
fields.description: Native TCP port (not the HTTP interface port)

fields.name: encrypt
fields.label: Encrypt
fields.description: 'yes' to require SSL (e.g. Azure SQL); 'no' for a local unencrypted instance

fields.name: database
fields.label: Database
fields.description: Defaults to 'my_db' on MotherDuck's side if left blank

bigquery.description: Paste the full GCP service-account key JSON (GCP Console -> IAM & Admin -> Service Accounts -> your account -> Keys -> Add Key -> JSON). Used verbatim -- dlt's GcpServiceAccountCredentials parses a raw JSON string directly, so no connection-string assembly happens here.

destination_credentials_env_var.label: Destination Credentials Env Var
destination_credentials_env_var.description: Env var holding the destination connection string.

destination_bucket_url.label: Bucket Url (destination)
destination_bucket_url.description: Bucket/path URL for filesystem-shaped DESTINATION storage (this is the field named 'bucket_url' in every other ingestion component in this repo -- renamed here because 'bucket_url' is the filesystem SOURCE field above). Required when destination='filesystem' is the final target; also used as the staging area when destination='databricks' or 'athena'. See ../DESTINATIONS.md.

athena_query_result_bucket.label: Athena Query Result Bucket
athena_query_result_bucket.description: Optional S3 path where Athena writes query results (e.g. 's3://my-bucket/results/'). Only used when destination='athena'. May be omitted to use Athena-managed query results instead.

kinds.label: Kinds
kinds.description: Asset kinds for the catalog. Auto-inferred from source_type/destination if not set.

freshness_cron.label: Freshness Cron
freshness_cron.description: Cron schedule string for the freshness policy.

include_preview_metadata.label: Include Preview Metadata
include_preview_metadata.description: Include sample data preview in metadata

preview_rows.label: Preview Rows
preview_rows.description: Rows to include in the preview metadata.

deps.label: Deps
deps.description: Upstream asset keys this asset depends on

partition_type.label: Partition Type
partition_type.description: Partition type: 'daily' / 'weekly' / 'monthly' / 'hourly' / 'cron' / 'static' / 'multi' / 'dynamic' / None. Set partition_date_column (time partitions) or partition_static_column (static/dynamic/multi) to filter the returned rows to the partition.

partition_cron_fmt.label: Partition Cron Fmt
partition_cron_fmt.description: strftime format for partition keys produced by partition_type='cron'.

partition_end_offset.label: Partition End Offset
partition_end_offset.description: Passed through to the underlying time-based partitions definition. 0 (default) excludes the current, still-in-progress window.

partition_timezone.label: Partition Timezone
partition_timezone.description: IANA timezone for the underlying partitions definition (defaults to UTC).

partition_start.label: Partition Start
partition_start.description: Partition start date in ISO format. Required for time-based partition types.

partition_values.label: Partition Values
partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static or multi partitioning.

partition_date_column.description: Column used to filter the returned DataFrame to the current date partition (time partitions).
partition_date_column.label: Partition Date Column

partition_static_column.description: Column used to filter the returned DataFrame to the current static/dynamic partition key.
partition_static_column.label: Partition Static Column

partition_window_params.label: Partition Window Params
partition_window_params.description: source_type='rest_api' only: push the partition's time window into the API requests so each partition fetches only its own slice: {start_param, end_param, format (iso | date | epoch | epoch_ms, default iso)}. Ignored (with a warning) for source_type='sql_database'/'filesystem'. Needs a time partition_type.

partition_window_resources.label: Partition Window Resources
partition_window_resources.description: Resources that take partition_window_params (default: all, rest_api only).

backfill_policy.label: Backfill Policy
backfill_policy.description: Backfill strategy for a partitioned asset. Unset keeps Dagster's default.

backfill_policy_max_partitions_per_run.label: Backfill Max Partitions Per Run
backfill_policy_max_partitions_per_run.description: For backfill_policy='multi_run' only: maximum partitions materialized per run (default 1).
